scope: Narrow actual Cocos Web/HTML test-build playback probe in isolated browser storage; not TapTap/device or human listening acceptance

data.openingSkip: Actual app skip action only if opening was active; no Music.ts override

stages.name: preload-only-all-four-families-and-45-v9-clips

stages.name: one-keyj-WAR-soft

setup.note: Shield idle/front gives the real fallback metal guard; recovery-held shield gives a real unguarded soft hit. No hit/material event is injected.

limitations: Four controlled WAR/BOW targets use actual GameSession KeyJ actions, collision, hit/guard material and Cocos AudioSources. Each case sends KeyJ exactly once.
Loadout, level, empty nearby scene, non-attacking target and target ID are controlled fixtures, not ordinary progression or enemy-art acceptance.
Target IDs are selected with the existing deterministic contact-roll helper for the next normal attack/projectile; accuracy and damage functions are not overridden.
FIR/THU assets are preloaded only. No magic skill, VFX, music transition or 15-second music replay is tested.
AudioSource requests, STARTED events and actual playing/currentTime observations are evidence of engine playback intent/state, not human auditory approval.
Cocos may invoke play again when dispatching a queued operation; logical CombatAudio requests are counted separately from source-level invocations.
